change: The deploy walk leaves pubkit for pubdeploy (Sustenaut/pubdeploy): pubkit deploy walk, check and types, pubkit k8s preflight and diagnose, k8s-deploy.yml, deploy-check.yml and k8s/components/app are gone, with no stubs; run ./pubdeploy, which pubkit sync writes in a repository with a deploy block, and call pubdeploy's workflows. deploy.providers now lists pubdeploy at pubkit's floor beside pubsec, ./pubkit runs with it, and sync and bump call the new sustenaut.sync and sustenaut.bump hook groups, pubdeploy's being the deploy block's offline check, the scheduled walk's caller, and moving deploy.providers and the uses of pubdeploy's workflows. deploy-ssh stays until pubdeploy calls its own copy
